title: Fynkel physics material
description: `<name>.physicsmaterial.json` (ADR-0025, `docs/physics.md` § Physics materials): the friction and bounciness every `fynkel.Collider` whose `material` names this document collides with, and how they combine with the other collider's — Unity's Physics Material. Every field is optional; an absent one takes Unity's default. A collider without a material uses its own `friction` and `restitution`, averaged.

friction.description: The Coulomb friction coefficient, static and sliding alike (Rapier has one): 0 is ice, 1 is rubber on concrete.

bounciness.description: Restitution: 0 stops dead on impact, 1 bounces back as fast as it came.

friction_combine.description: How this friction and the other collider's become the contact's.

bounce_combine.description: How this bounciness and the other collider's (its material's, or its own `restitution`) become the contact's.

combine.description: `average` (a + b) / 2, `minimum` min(a, b), `multiply` a × b, `maximum` max(a, b). When the two colliders' rules differ, the later one in this list wins (a collider without a material averages).
